{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Coorsha's Cross''''' was an [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] that saw service during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The carrier was captured by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Coorsha]], who re-named the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] after himself, and the vessel was subsequently deployed by Coorsha's pirate forces.
